const now = new Date();
function hoursAgoISO(h){ return new Date(now.getTime() - Number(h) * 3600000).toISOString(); }

let rows = [];
if (CONFIG.mode === "LIVE") {
  rows = (CONFIG.live_candidates || []).map(function(c){ return Object.assign({}, c, { data_label: "LIVE INPUT" }); });
} else {
  rows = DEMO.map(function(c){
    const o = Object.assign({}, c, { data_label: "DEMO DATA - SYNTHETIC CANDIDATES - NOT REAL PEOPLE" });
    o.applied_at = hoursAgoISO(c.applied_hours_ago);
    delete o.applied_hours_ago;
    return o;
  });
}

if (!rows.length) {
  return [{ json: { halt: true, status: "REQUIRES_REVIEW", review_reasons: ["NO_INPUT_CANDIDATES"],
    note: "No candidates supplied. In LIVE mode add records to CONFIG.live_candidates (node 2).",
    run_mode: CONFIG.mode, workflow_version: CONFIG.workflow_version } }];
}

return rows.map(function(r){
  return { json: Object.assign({ run_mode: CONFIG.mode, workflow_version: CONFIG.workflow_version,
    received_at: now.toISOString(), status: "OK", review_reasons: [] }, r) };
});

parameters.content:
## TalentFlow Engine - inbound candidate triage
Synthetic demo data: no real people. Recommendations only. A recruiter decides everything; no message is sent automatically.

Everything configurable lives in **2. Load CONFIG** (jobs, skills taxonomy, scoring weights, tiers, recruiters, LLM prompt, endpoints).

### Data quality
Normalise names, emails, phones (E.164), titles. Dedupe on email / phone / name+location. Simulated CRM lookup flags existing records, do-not-contact and recently-contacted candidates.

### Fair screening
Protected-characteristic terms and contact details are redacted before scoring and before any LLM call. Transparent 0-100 score with a must-have gate.

### LLM with guardrails
Deterministic baseline always runs. The LLM can only make the recommendation MORE cautious, cannot invent skills, and is filtered for protected terms. Failures fall back to baseline and flag REQUIRES_REVIEW.

### Outputs / integration points
Salesforce upsert (Contact + Candidate_Match__c), Airtable upsert, Clay webhook, HTML dashboard. Push is OFF by default. MCP tools: see CONFIG.endpoints.mcp_integration_points.
